source: بسمی النّاطق فی ملکوت البیان
reference: In My Name, calling aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
hyps: In My Name calling aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
In My Name which proclaimeth in the Kingdom of Utterance.
In My Name that calleth aloud in the kingdom of utterance
In My Name which calleth aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance,

source: حمد و ثنا سلطان مبین را لایق و سزاست که سجن متین را بحضور حضرت علیّ قبل اکبر و حضرت امین مزیّن فرمود و بانوار ایقان و استقامت و اطمینان مزیّن داشت.
reference: Praise and thanksgiving beseem the Lord of manifest dominion Who hath adorned the mighty prison with the presence of their honors 'Alí-Akbar and Amín, and hath illumined it with the light of certitude, constancy and assurance.
hyps: All praise and glory be to the King of manifest authority, who hath glorified the dread dungeon by the presence of his honored son 'Alí-Muqaddas and that of Amín, and hath adorned it with the lights of certitude and constancy and peace.

Magnified and celebrated be the King of obvious sovereignty! He hath adorned this strong prison with the presence of Ali-Akbar and Amín before, and hath illuminated it with the luminaries of certitude, constancy, and assurance.
Praise be unto God Who hath made this manifest King worthy of His exalted station by causing Him to occupy that august position and to adorn it with the light of faith, of constancy and of peace.

All praise be to God, the Lord of all men, inasmuch as He hath permitted this mighty Prison to become, through the presence of His honored son 'Alí-Akbar and His appointed Successor Amín, a place of glory and abode of peace and tranquility.

source: علیهما بهآء الله و بهآء من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
reference: The glory of God and the glory of all that are in the heavens and on the earth be upon them.
hyps: The glory of God and His creatures be upon them.
Upon them rest the glory of God and the glory of all who are in heaven and on earth.
Upon them rest the glory of God, and the glory of all that are in the heavens and on earth.
Upon them be the brightness of God and of all that are in heaven and on earth.

source: النّور و البهآء و التّکبیر و الثّنآء علی ایادی امره الّذین بهم اشرق نور الاصطبار و ثبت حکم الاختیار لله المقتدر العزیز المختار و بهم ماج بحر العطآء و هاج عرف عنایة الله مولی الوری.
reference: Light and glory, greeting and praise be upon the Hands of His Cause, through whom the light of fortitude hath shone forth and the truth hath been established that the authority to choose rests with God, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Unconstrained, through whom the ocean of bounty hath surged and the fragrance of the gracious favors of God, the Lord of mankind, hath been diffused.
hyps: His glory, His light, His salutations, His praise, rest upon those Who are the instruments of His Cause, through Whom the light of fortitude hath shone forth and the proof that the right to choose is reserved unto God, Him Whose might is infinite, Whose power none can resist, hath been established, through Whom the ocean of bounty hath surged and the sweet savors of the loving providence of God, the Lord of all mankind, have been diffused.

Illuminating rays, glorious splendors, blessings and praise be upon them whose hands are the implements of His Cause, through which the light of patience hath shone forth, and the precept 'it is God that hath authority to prescribe' hath been established, for God, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Potent, hath chosen to make it thus. Through them have surged the waves of bounty and the breeze of the love of God, the Lord of mankind.

All praise be unto His servants, whose hands are the source of divine light and splendor, who shine forth like the shining stars of patience, whose will is to do only what God has decreed, the Most Powerful, the All-Possessing, the One Who hath choice amongst all things, through Whose acts the ocean of His bounty ebbs and flows, and the fragrance of the loving-kindness of God, the Lord of all men, hath been shed abroad.

By His mighty hands were spread the rays of glory, the symbols of praise, the emblem of blessing and the standard of victory, through which the light of constancy was shed abroad, and the law of God's unerring guidance established amongst men, a law to which all must bow, Who is the Lord of strength, the God of power and might, the Supreme Ordainer, and from Whose grace the sea of bounty hath surged, and the fragrance of His loving-kindness been wafted over all mankind.

source: نسأله تعالی ان یحفظهم بجنوده و یحرسهم بسلطانه و ینصرهم بقدرته الّتی غلبت الأشیآء.
reference: We beseech Him—exalted is He—to shield them through the power of His hosts, to protect them through the potency of His dominion and to aid them through His indomitable strength which prevaileth over all created things.
hyps: We beseech Him—exalted be He—to keep them safe through His Hosts, to protect them through the power of His sovereignty, and to aid them through His all overpowering strength which hath prevailed against all created things.
We entreat Him—exalted be He—to guard them through His hosts, to protect them through His sovereignty, to succor them through His power that hath prevailed over all created things.
We entreat Him—glorified be He—to guard them through His hosts, to protect them through His sovereignty and to succor them through His power that hath prevailed against all created things.
We beseech Him—exalted be He—to protect them through His hosts, to guard them through His sovereignty, and to aid them through His all-conquering power.

source: الملک لله فاطر السّمآء و مالک ملکوت الأسمآء.
reference: Sovereignty is God's, the Creator of the heavens and the Lord of the Kingdom of Names.
hyps: All sovereignty is God's, the Creator of the heavens and the Possessor of the kingdom of names.
Dominion is God's. He hath fashioned the heavens and is the King of the kingdoms of names.
The Kingdom is Gods, the Creator of heaven, the Possessor of the Kingdom of names.
All sovereignty is God's, the Creator of the heavens, the King of the realm of names.

source: نبأ عظیم میفرماید ای اصحاب ایران.
reference: The Great Announcement proclaimeth: O people of Persia.
hyps: Unto you who dwell in Persia hath a Great Announcement been revealed, saying: O people of Persia.
He saith in great exhortation to the people of Persia: O peoples of Persia.
Great is the announcement which He maketh, saying: O ye inhabitants of Persia.
The Great Announcement saith: O people of Persia.

source: شما مشارق رحمت و مطالع شفقت و محبّت بوده‌اید.
reference: In former times ye have been the symbols of mercy and the embodiments of affection and kindliness.
hyps: Ye have been the symbols of kindness, the evidences of affection and fellowship.
Ye were the dawning places of mercy, and the daysprings of kindness and love.
Ye have been the symbols of mercy and the embodiments of kindliness and charity.
Ye have been the symbols of mercy and the emblems of affection and loving-kindness.

source: و آفاق وجود بنور خرد و دانش شما منوّر و مزیّن بوده.
reference: The regions of the world were illumined and embellished by the brightness of the light of your knowledge and by the blaze of your erudition.
hyps: Then the horizons of men were illumined and adorned with the light of your reason and knowledge.
The whole world hath been illumined and adorned with the radiance of your understanding and wisdom.
The world hath been illumined and adorned through the light of your understanding and wisdom.
The world of existence hath ever been illumined by the light of thy intellect and wisdom.

source: آیا چه شد که بدست خود بر هلاکت خود و دوستان خود قیام کردید.
reference: How is it that you have arisen to destroy yourselves and your friends with your own hands.
hyps: How is it that ye have arisen to destroy yourselves and your friends with your own hands.
Wherefore have ye so determined to destroy yourselves and others who love you.
Whence hath come this thing, that ye have arisen to take your own lives and the lives of your friends into your own hands.
How is it that ye have arisen with your own hands to destroy yourselves and your friends?

source: یا افنانی.
reference: O Afnán, O thou that hast branched from Mine ancient Stock.
hyps: O Afnán, O thou Who art the Branch of My Vine.
O My Branches.
O Afnán.
O Afván.

source: علیک بهائی و عنایتی.
reference: My glory and My loving-kindness rest upon thee.
hyps: My glory be upon thee, and My loving-kindness.
On thee be My glory and My loving-kindness.
Upon thee be My glory and My loving kindness.
My glory and My loving-kindness rest upon thee.

source: خیمهٴ امر الهی عظیم است.
reference: How vast is the tabernacle of the Cause of God.
hyps: How vast is the tabernacle of divine revelation!
How vast the Tabernacle that God hath pitched.
How vast the tabernacle of His Revelation!
How vast is the Tabernacle of the Cause of God.

source: جمیع احزاب عالم را فراگرفته و خواهد گرفت.
reference: It hath overshadowed all the peoples and kindreds of the earth, and will, ere long, gather together the whole of mankind beneath its shelter.
hyps: It hath encompassed all the peoples and kindreds of the earth, and will ere long embrace them all.
Such a power can encompass the whole of mankind, and will ultimately succeed in gathering all its kindreds and peoples into its fold.
It hath combined the interests of every element in the world, and will in the future continue to do so.
It hath encompassed the whole world, and shall eventually absorb all its peoples.

source: روز روز شماست.
reference: Thy day of service is now come.
hyps: It is the Day that will be repeated.
Every day is thine own day.
To day is thy day.
The day ye are to be remembered is thine own day.

source: و هزار لوح گواه شما بر نصرت امر قیام نمائید.
reference: Countless Tablets bear the testimony of the bounties vouchsafed unto thee.
hyps: A myriad Tablets bear Thy testimony to this truth.
Thousands of Tablets testify to the righteousness of this Cause, yet its Cause is still in peril.
Thousands upon thousands of Tablets bear Thou Thy witness unto the triumph which will crown this Revelation.
Innumerable Tablets are, at this moment, testifying to the righteousness of this Cause; raise them up.

source: و بجنود بیان بتسخیر افئده و قلوب اهل عالم مشغول شوید.
reference: Arise for the triumph of My Cause, and, through the power of thine utterance, subdue the hearts of men.
hyps: Set about conquering the souls of men through the power of thine utterance.
With the hosts of thine utterance set your souls on winning the hearts of men.
Arise with the hosts of thine utterance to conquer the hearts of men.
Arise to subdue the souls of men through the power of the words thou didst utter.

source: باید از شما ظاهر شود آنچه که سبب آسایش و راحت بیچارگان روزگار است.
reference: Thou must show forth that which will ensure the peace and the well-being of the miserable and the downtrodden.
hyps: It behooveth thee to reveal that which will be conducive to the well-being and comfort of the down-trodden of the earth.
It behooveth thee to show forth that which will conduce to the comfort and well-being of the distressed and the down-trodden.
It behooveth thee to show forth that which will ensure the peace and well-being of all those unfortunate creatures.
There must needs be discovered in you that which will assure the well-being and tranquility of this miserable people.

source: کمر همّت را محکم نمائید شاید بندگان از اسیری فارغ شوند و بآزادی رسند.
reference: Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that perchance thou mayest release the captive from his chains, and enable him to attain unto true liberty.
hyps: Gird up the loins of endeavor, that perchance the captive may be released from his chains and attain unto liberty.
Strive ye to tighten the bonds of effort that perchance the captive may become free and attain unto liberty.
Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that haply the captive may be released from bondage and attain unto true liberty.
Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that haply thy servants may be released from their bondage and attain unto liberty.

source: امروز نالهٴ عدل بلند و حنین انصاف مرتفع.
reference: Justice is, in this day, bewailing its plight, and Equity groaneth beneath the yoke of oppression.
hyps: In this Day, the cry of Justice and the voice of Equity are raised.
The voice of justice calleth aloud in this Day, and the cry of equity is raised upon every tongue.
Justice protesteth against the things thou dost, and equity laments thy behavior.
Justice is being stifled, and fairness is groaning today.
